trickyParts: suggestionsBehindLock checks the answer channel before every pg_locks poll, so an answer that arrives before any backend queues behind the holder fails at once; once a waiter is seen it receives the answer with no timer (plan decision 2).
The waiter query runs through the holder transaction (pg_backend_pid() = any(pg_blocking_pids(pid))), so it needs no pool connection and counts only backends blocked by the test's own lock.
Test 1 no longer seeds an answered ask: with asks locked the fused search waits first, so the decision lookup is never reached (sjawhar/legion#2158).
t.Fatalf in the helper reports at the caller's line because of t.Helper().
